topic: K-Stick and the Mirror That Copies Him Late
hook_text: Why is K-Stick's reflection always one move behind?
background: Simple bedroom or hallway with a large wall mirror
main_expression: Confused wide eyes that turn into an amused grin
main_pose: Standing in front of the mirror, waving, then pointing suspiciously at his reflection
scene_1: K-Stick walks up to the mirror, adjusts his red cap, and smiles proudly.
scene_2: He waves, but the reflection waves a moment later. K-Stick freezes, then rapidly changes poses to test it.
scene_3: The reflection keeps lagging behind, making every pose look hilariously out of sync.
twist_ending: K-Stick walks away, but his delayed reflection finally catches up, steps out of the mirror, and takes his place. K-Stick returns, sees the new reflection, and both stare at each other in confusion.
facebook_caption: K-Stick found a mirror with terrible internet connection! 😂🪞
youtube_description: K-Stick discovers that his reflection is running on a delay. But when it finally catches up, the mirror mystery gets even funnier!
image_prompt: A clean colorful 2D cartoon scene for a short funny stickman animation, K-Stick is a simple black stickman with a round white face, huge expressive eyes, and a signature red cap, standing in front of a large rectangular wall mirror in a simple bedroom or hallway, playful family-friendly style, bold outlines, minimal reusable background, no text, no copyrighted characters.
motion_prompt: 15-second comedic animation with quick timing: K-Stick enters and adjusts his red cap, smiles at the mirror, and waves. His reflection waves half a second late. K-Stick tests it with fast poses and exaggerated confused reactions while the reflection copies each move late. K-Stick walks away; after a beat, the reflection steps out of the mirror and stands in his place. K-Stick pops back in, both characters stare at each other, then shrug simultaneously. Use simple squash-and-stretch, quick zooms, and a cheerful pop sound for the final shrug.
